packsize.note: For bundle_type='multipack' the packsize carries a multiplier suffix: '{gramasi} {satuan} x {N} pcs' (N = bundle_quantity).

sku_type_complete.note: sub_brand already begins with the brand, e.g. brand='A Bonne' -> sub_brand='A Bonne Hokkaido Milk Whitening Lotion' -> sku_type_complete='A Bonne Hokkaido Milk Whitening Lotion 400 ml'.

keywords.note: keywords = sku_type_complete plus a single trailing space (3125/3163 existing rows).
